title: Thinking of Heavenly Father at Night
traveler_why: Wren is the Wonderer whose motto is pause and ponder, and tonight’s psalm is about a person who ponders Heavenly Father in bed at night, remembering all the good things He has done until his heart feels full.
traveler_about: Wren fits tonight because pondering is her gift. Pause and ponder is what Wren does best, and tonight’s psalm is about a person who pondered Heavenly Father at bedtime. When the world got quiet, he remembered the good things Heavenly Father had done, and his heart felt full. A wondering heart is a good heart to fall asleep with.
